about.title: About
about.description: Full-stack developer in Konya, Türkiye. I build web applications and run the infrastructure they ship on.
about.lead: I build web applications with Next.js, Node.js/Express and MongoDB.
about.body1: I also run what I ship: Docker, GitHub Actions, Coolify, Traefik and Linux on my own servers. In teams I work Agile, with sprint planning and tracking in ClickUp.
about.body2: Networking and security sit under that application work. I'm CAPT certified, and I've finished the Cisco CCNA track plus CyberOps Associate. I care about how a system is deployed and what it exposes, not only how the code is written.
about.body3: Outside of work I spent two years as a GDG Konya organizer and was on the GDG Cloud Konya core team. We ran talks, study jams and workshops for the local developer community.
about.now: Full-Stack Developer at BerrSoft, studying Mathematics and Computer Science at Necmettin Erbakan University
about.languages: Turkish is my native language. I work in written English every day: documentation, repositories and the posts on this site.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Write about a project, a role, or a question on self-hosted infrastructure. I read every message and reply within a few days.
contact.intro: If you have a project or a question, email or WhatsApp both reach me.
contact.ctaBody: Tell me what you are building. I usually reply within two to three business days.
contact.whatsappPrefill: Hello, I am writing from your site.
contact.trustBody: Form data reaches me by email through Resend, the mail provider this site uses, and is not shared or sold. Visit counts come from a self-hosted Umami instance that does not use cookies, and only after you allow measurement.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How this site handles visits, messages and the measurement choice stored in your browser.
privacy.lead: This page is the short version of who I am, what the site stores, and how visit counts work.
privacy.whoBody: I am Doğan Can YILDIZ. This site is my portfolio. For questions about this notice, use the contact form or email me at the address in the footer.
privacy.storageBody: Theme preference is stored by the browser (localStorage), not as a cookie. Your measurement choice is stored the same way, under the key dcy-consent. Neither is sent to me as a tracking cookie.
privacy.analyticsBody: If you allow it, visits are counted by a self-hosted Umami instance on my own server. Umami does not set a cookie. The script loads only after you say yes. Necessary storage (theme and this choice) does not wait on that yes.
privacy.formBody: The form sends your name, email and message to me through Resend. I use that to reply. I do not sell it or pass it to anyone else.
privacy.contactBody: To ask about this notice or to reach me about work, use the contact page.

consent.title: Visit counts
consent.body: This site does not use measurement cookies. Theme stays in your browser. Visit counts (Umami, cookieless, on my server) load only if you allow them.

errorPage.title: This page failed to load
errorPage.description: Trying again often fixes it. If it does not, the error has been logged on the server.
